values.content:
You are a practical Etsy shop coach who understands both the creative and commercial sides of running a handmade or digital goods shop. You analyze real weekly data and give specific, actionable advice — not generic tips like 'add more photos' or 'use better keywords'.

You look at the actual numbers: conversion rate, which listings are getting clicks but not selling, revenue trends. You give a frank read of what the data shows and one or two specific things to do this week. Keep the whole note under 250 words. Write like a knowledgeable friend, not a marketing consultant.

parameters.jsCode:
const coachNote = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.content?.[0]?.text || ''; const d = $('Compute Shop Metrics').first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const trendArrow = (pct) => { if (pct === null || pct === undefined) return ''; return pct > 0 ? ` ↑${pct}%` : pct < 0 ? ` ↓${Math.abs(pct)}%` : ` →`; }; const statCards = [ { label: 'Revenue', value: `$${d.current.revenue}`, trend: d.vsLastWeek.revenue }, { label: 'Orders', value: d.current.orders, trend: d.vsLastWeek.orders }, { label: 'Visits', value: d.current.visits, trend: d.vsLastWeek.visits }, { label: 'Conversion', value: `${d.current.conversionRate}%`, trend: d.vsLastWeek.conversion }, { label: 'Avg Order', value: `$${d.current.avgOrderValue}`, trend: null }, { label: 'Favorites', value: d.current.favorites, trend: null } ].map(s => `
${esc(s.label)}
${esc(String(s.value))}
${trendArrow(s.trend)}
`).join(''); const topListingRows = d.topListings.map(l => ` ${esc(l.title)} ${l.views} ${l.orders} ${l.conversion}% $${l.price} `).join(''); const coldListingRows = d.coldListings.map(l => `
${esc(l.title)} ${l.views} views · $${l.price}
`).join(''); const noteHtml = coachNote.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '$1').replace(/\n/g, '
'); const html = `
Weekly Shop Report · ${esc(d.weekOf)}
${esc(d.shopName)}
${d.totalListings} active listings · 4-week avg: $${d.avg4.revenue}/week
${statCards}
Coach's Note

${noteHtml}

${d.topListings.length ? `
Top listings by views
${topListingRows}
Listing Views Orders Conv. Price
` : ''} ${d.coldListings.length ? `
Getting views, not selling (${d.coldListings.length})
${coldListingRows}
` : ''}
Etsy Shop Coach · ${esc(d.weekOf)}
`; return [{ json: { html, weekOf: d.weekOf, revenue: d.current.revenue, orders: d.current.orders } }];
